title: Fixed Open Plate-and-Frame Filter Press
description: One newly authored complete static horizontal ore-processing filter-press appearance: six thick double-recess square plates with real central through bores and integral lateral rail lugs sit on two full support rails between a grounded fixed inlet head and plunger-tail frame. One plate is deliberately pulled clear of the close row so its whole recessed face can be read; this is one fixed display, not animation. A full solid pressure head, smooth plunger through a truly bored tail bearing, integral end boss and transverse handle complete the axial end arrangement. A separate low open collector basin rests on two full lower supports. All geometry newly authored, not a scaled bench vise with extra jaws, rotated basket screw press, more dressing-table riffles or extracted old components. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, actual whole horizontal bounds centred and four full end-frame feet at Z0. One prop, no scene or separately counted plates. Opaque untextured constant PBR materials. Static art only: no membrane medium, liquid, actual filtering, compression, plate movement, pressure seals, thread engagement, throughput, maintenance access, load, manufacturing, food-contact, installation or equipment safety claim.
